title: 3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim Opened � Not in CS � Non-EU Country � Rejected
goal: Validates that when a claims company submits on behalf of a passenger, the claim was opened by the passenger, the case number is not found in CS, and the country of origin is a non-EU country (e.g., Canada), the system rejects the third-party submission and advises the passenger to file themselves.

checkpoints.step: Validates that when a claims company submits on behalf of a passenger, the claim was opened by the passenger, the case number is not found in CS, and the country of origin is a non-EU country (e.g., Canada), the system rejects the third-party submission and advises the passenger to file themselves.
Third-party caller type: Claims Company
Passenger has opened a claim
Case number provided does not exist in Case Services
checkpoints.expected: Case number provided does not exist in Case Services

checkpoints.step: Country of origin: Canada
Given the user opens the agentic chatbot Then the chatbot displays greeting (GLOB-01)
Then user selects English Then chatbot asks "How can I help you today?"
checkpoints.expected: How can I help you today?

checkpoints.step: And the user says "I'm calling from a claims company on behalf of a passenger regarding a flight disruption claim"
checkpoints.expected: I'm calling from a claims company on behalf of a passenger regarding a flight disruption claim

checkpoints.step: When the chatbot identifies flight disruption intent
Then the chatbot checks: Is this a third-party submission? ? YES
Then the chatbot identifies third-party type ? Claims Company
Then the chatbot asks: "Has a claim been opened by the passenger?"
checkpoints.expected: Has a claim been opened by the passenger?

checkpoints.step: And the user responds: "Yes"
Then the chatbot responds: "Please provide a case number and the name of one of the passengers on the claim."
checkpoints.expected: Please provide a case number and the name of one of the passengers on the claim.

checkpoints.step: And the user provides: Case number "CLM-98765" and passenger name "Jean-Pierre Martin"
And the user provides: "Canada"

Then the chatbot responds: "Claims for flight disruption which occurred in Canada must be submitted by the passenger who experienced the disruption. Third parties cannot submit claims for disruption that occur in Canada. Please advise the passenger to open a claim themselves."
checkpoints.expected: Claims for flight disruption which occurred in Canada must be submitted by the passenger who experienced the disruption. Third parties cannot submit claims for disruption that occur in Canada. Please advise the passenger to open a claim themselves.

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot offers: "Is there anything I can help you with?"
checkpoints.expected: Is there anything I can help you with?

checkpoints.step: And the user selects "No"
Then the chatbot responds "Thank you for choosing Air Canada."
checkpoints.expected: Thank you for choosing Air Canada.

checkpoints.step: Given the system correctly identifies the third-party as a Claims Company
And the claim has been opened as YES
And the case number and passenger name have been collected
And the CS lookup returns NOT FOUND
And the country is "Canada" which is non-EU
Then the system should display the rejection message with the correct country name inserted
And the flow should end with no manual handoff
And no case should be created in Claims Dashboard
And when searching Claims Dashboard no entry should exist for this third-party submission
Given the third-party submission was rejected for non-EU country
Then no payment flow should be triggered
And no case should exist in Claims Dashboard
And no compensation record should have been created
